detail: Findings: Plugin v1.9.1 published via marketplace (PR-less direct main commit) with sentinel-based pre-commit hook — fixes #11 (latency, substring) and #13 (escaped quotes).; npm v1.20.0 published via tag-trigger — adds twining_archive_stale, staleness_review and merge_sweep flags on twining_housekeeping, archived DecisionStatus, provenance stamping. Closes #7 (deterministic portion).; #16 filed for deferred LLM-judged semantic-content review piece of #7 (Wave 3 / HMS Lancaster case).
summary: Session shipped plugin v1.9.1 (hook fix #11, #13), npm v1.20.0 (closes #7 deterministic portion via PR #15 + #17), filed #16 for deferred LLM-judged semantic review.
